messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Is sertraline the same as Zoloft?
:
Yes.
Sertraline is the active ingredient.
Zoloft is the brand name Sertraline is sold under in the United States.
Sertraline is the generic version of Zoloft.
The two contain the same medicine, sertraline hydrochloride.
You may also see sertraline written as sertraline HCl.
Is sertraline an SSRI, and how does sertraline work?
:
Yes, sertraline is an SSRI, which stands for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
Nerve cells in the brain release serotonin to send signals.
Then, they reabsorb serotonin.
Sertraline blocks that reabsorption.
More serotonin stays available between nerve cells.
Sertraline has very little effect on norepinephrine.
Sertraline has very little effect on dopamine.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on adrenergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on cholinergic receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on GABA receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on histamine receptors.
Sertraline has no meaningful effect on benzodiazepine receptors.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has very little effect on", "norepinephrine"]

The relation 'has very little effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has minimal interaction with or influence on the neurotransmitter or system specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces': The subject drug decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the anatomical or physiological entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'has inactive ingredient': The subject drug contains the inactive pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
